assertions.assert: Without a database it wakes with no description: on entering knowing it sends `bot.ability.persona.output` `{traits, description: null}` to the parent, traits the `<param>` `traits` in the owner's order with the white space around each stripped, then `bot.ability.offers` `{ability: "persona", choices}`, choices the one model-callable `bot.ability.persona.revise` with its schema made model-facing (no `$schema`, title or examples) and the schema's description, no target.

With a database it recalls the most recent description it wrote (query_tags `self_persona`, subject_ref `self`), else none, and tells and offers the same way; a recall attempt that fails or does not answer within `recall_attempt_timeout_ms` is asked again after `recall_retry_delay_ms`, and when the bring-up budget (`bring_up_timeout_ms`) runs out first it answers `bot.ability.failed` `{message: "Persona could not recall a description: memory did not answer within the bring-up budget."}` and then tells `bot.ability.persona.output` with no description.

`bot.ability.persona.revise` `{text, reason}` writes the description down (with a database; without one nothing is written) before it becomes the bot's, then tells `bot.ability.persona.output` `{traits, description: {text, reason, traits, kind: "fact"}}`, the owner's traits it was written under included, and offers again; each revision replaces the description before it.

A revise its schema refuses (a blank or empty text or reason, a text over 2000 characters, a reason over 500, any other field) is never routed: the sender gets `error.execution`, and the persona is unchanged.

A revise that cannot be written down is not taken: it answers `bot.ability.failed` `{message: "Persona could not remember its revision: ..."}`, tells nothing, keeps the description it had, and offers again.
A revise that arrives while it is recalling or revising is deferred and taken, in order, once it is back in knowing.

Traits that are not 1 to 24 traits of at most 200 characters (none given included) are refused where the output is created: it offers nothing and ends, its invoker getting `done.invoke.persona` with `{message}`.
